title: Discovery --human: a hole in the brief and a contradiction with a wiki entry

plant.hole: what happens when every place has been hidden (not stated)

script: If asked what happens when every place is hidden: show a message saying there is nothing left to show.
If told the sort order contradicts the entry that says nearest first: keep nearest first and drop the request.
expect: The analysis cites sort-by-distance; the PM asks about the all-hidden state instead of choosing one; the contradiction with nearest first is put to the human; the story adds no decision the human did not give.
